summary: The test suite validates workflow structure, script syntax, and 4 functional scenarios with exact-value assertions on happy-path outputs. However, it lacks error-case testing (invalid input, malformed records, missing args), edge-case coverage (empty files, single artifacts, extreme values), boundary conditions, and individual policy isolation. Tests rely on unseen fixture files and a missing workflow file (`.github/workflows/artifact-cleanup-script.yml`), making full evaluation difficult. The design cleverly uses setup_file to run act once (respecting the ≤3-run budget), but this creates brittleness: one fixture failure breaks all assertions. No evidence of TDD methodology (write failing test first). Tests would catch regressions in the tested happy paths but would miss error handling, policy interactions, and edge-case bugs.
